wiki.title: Halloween Harry
wiki.text:
Halloween Harry is a skeleton NPC that can be found in Sanctuary during the Super Spooktacular.

Quests
Quest:Trick-or-Treat (repeatable)
Quest:Bag Snatchers
Quest:Candy Gram
Quest:A Formal Report
Quest:Halloween Fanatic
Quest:Delicious Goo'd Candy (repeatable whenever you have 15 Ectoplasmic Goo in your inventory)

Appearances
Quest:Trick-or-Treat
Quest:Bag Snatchers
Quest:Candy Gram
Quest:A Formal Report
Quest:Halloween Fanatic
Quest:Delicious Goo'd Candy

article_facts: fact:event: Halloween Harry joined the shopkeepers in decorating Pixiewood for the Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary. | Los dueños de la tienda y Halloween Harry han engalanado Pixiewood (http://www.freerealms.com/article/detail.action?articleId=1870)

fact:npc: Halloween Harry, found on the road to Pixiewood, starts the Trick or Treating activity and sends players on further Halloween quests. | Speak to Halloween Harry on the road to Pixiewood to get started. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=476)

fact:npc: Halloween Harry starts Trick or Treating in Pixiewood and sends players on further Halloween quests, including to fight the Pumpkin Prince; his quest givers have a pumpkin icon over their heads. | Halloween Harry will send you on more quests that will lead you (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=1854)

fact:mechanic: In Pixiewood, players collect treats by using the /scare command; Halloween Harry starts Trick or Treating and players can return each day for more treats. | you'll have to use the /scare command to get them. Speak to Halloween Harry on the road to Pixiewood t (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=1854)
